subject: how to init new worker with every new connection

messages.author: 26b647b408a2e02e
messages.subject: how to init new worker with every new connection
parts:
My app have some regular tasks and some heavy tasks. The heavy tasks may take minutes to finish. I signed up for the basic plan, and set the app settings as follows:

4G instance
10 workers / instance, I think the total worker limit will be 20 since the RAM limit is 8G.
20 connections / worker
5% worker load factor

I want every new connection to start with new worker, until the limit is reached. This way at least within 20 users everybody can run the heavy tasks without blocking other users. After 20 users they have to share workers. I think my setting should have this effect, because the worker load factor is 10 * 5% = 1 connection.

However when I start one connection, run the heavy task, then try to connect to app in another browser tab, it will not be connected until the first connection task finish. I even changed the worker load factor to 1%, still the same.

How can I change the settings to archive my goal? Or is that not possible?

messages.author: 26b647b408a2e02e
messages.subject: Re: how to init new worker with every new connection
parts: I changed the settings to start 2 instance in startup. I can have several connections doing the heavy tasks at the same time now. Not sure what is the optimal setting for my case.
